timeline.detail: Founded Zero Bytes to deliver real-adversary cybersecurity rather than checklist compliance. The firm serves SaaS companies, financial institutions, and regulated enterprises across penetration testing (external, application, API, mobile), identity assessments, phishing simulations, threat intelligence monitoring, and ISO 27001 / PCI-DSS compliance readiness. Built alongside concurrent advisory and enterprise engagements; moved to full operational leadership in 2025 following the conclusion of the Conduent engagement.

Early investor and Part-time CTO at CypherBox, an open-source Bitcoin wallet built on React Native delivering progressive self-custody for everyday users. Delivered a unified wallet experience spanning five integrations: Strike and Coinos for Lightning Network payments and fiat onramps, Ark Vault for next-generation Bitcoin Layer 2 transactions, Hot Wallet for self-custodial BIP39/SegWit coin control, and Cold Storage for PSBT-based hardware wallet signing via ColdCard, Keystone, and Jade. Architected the security model and technical roadmap across iOS and Android, with full ownership over private key management, UTXO design, and responsible vulnerability disclosure for the open-source contributor base.

Operating a senior consulting practice across three disciplines: cybersecurity advisory and senior security leadership programs, blockchain and Web3 architecture, and enterprise digital transformation. Clients span fintech organisations, enterprise businesses, and government-adjacent programmes across Africa, the Middle East, and Europe. Engagements are structured as part-time retainers, fixed-scope projects, or embedded advisory.

Designed a HIPAA-compliant healthcare identity infrastructure for US government agencies using Hyperledger Fabric and Self-Sovereign Identity (SSI) models. Architected a tokenised access management system that replaced centralised medical data custody with cryptographic credential control, giving patients and providers verifiable, auditable access without a central data store. Concurrently led the Royal Caribbean digital pilot: experience tokens for VIP services and concierge automation. Advised on welfare benefits distribution, IoT-integrated auditable access control, and supply chain verification.

Served as CTO, owning technical strategy and digital product delivery for a client portfolio across the Gulf region. Led development of AI-powered conversational interfaces, brand and e-commerce platforms, and paid digital acquisition products. Managed technical teams, agency vendor relationships, and delivery timelines across concurrent high-traffic campaigns. Drove measurable commercial outcomes through data-informed product decisions aligned with client revenue objectives.

Engineered ShoogirCash: a national e-Wallet integrated with the Central Bank of Sudan (CBOS) Consumer API for real-time settlement and clearing. ShoogirCash processed approximately 69% of Sudan's online payment transactions during 2015–16, becoming the country's de-facto digital payments rail. Built secure RESTful payment services, a tokenised transaction layer, and a multi-tier commission engine handling complex agent-network business structures. Operated concurrently with advisory engagements.

Designed and delivered the PETRONAS Enterprise Fuel eCoupon platform: a closed-loop, fraud-resistant prepaid fuel coupon system serving corporate clients and Petronas station agents across the national network. The platform covered online coupon ordering, watermarked serialised coupon generation, station-level claim and verification, and a credit redemption workflow converting redeemed coupons into bulk fuel order balance. Gave PETRONAS full lifecycle visibility and audit trail over every coupon issued, claimed, and settled.

list.title: ShoogirCash: National Digital Payments Rail
list.summary: Challenge: Sudan had no reliable digital payments infrastructure. Banks operated in isolation, settlement was manual, and the Central Bank of Sudan (CBOS) had no consumer-facing API integration with commercial systems. Action: Engineered ShoogirCash, a national e-Wallet directly integrated with the CBOS Consumer API for real-time settlement and clearing. Built a tokenised payment layer, multi-tier commission engine for agent networks, and a merchant portal with consumer mobile interface. Result: ShoogirCash processed approximately 69% of Sudan's online payment transactions in 2015-16, becoming the country's de-facto digital payments rail.
outcomes: ~69% of Sudan online payment volume processed at peak (2015–16)
Central Bank of Sudan (CBOS) API integration for real-time settlement and clearing
Tokenised RESTful payment gateway with secure transaction handling
Multi-tier commission engine for complex agent-network business structures
Merchant portal and consumer mobile wallet interface

list.title: PETRONAS Enterprise Fuel eCoupon Platform
list.summary: Challenge: PETRONAS needed a fraud-resistant prepaid fuel system for corporate clients, one that gave full lifecycle visibility over every coupon issued, redeemed, and settled across a national station network. Action: Designed a closed-loop eCoupon platform: enterprises order prepaid fuel coupons online, print watermarked serialised vouchers, distribute to employees. Station agents submit coupons through a claim portal to receive fuel credit, which converts to bulk fuel ordering balance. Every coupon tracked from issuance to settlement. Result: Full audit trail and tamper-evident lifecycle for the national corporate fuel programme, eliminating coupon fraud and enabling precise station-level settlement.
outcomes: Closed-loop, fraud-resistant corporate fuel prepayment infrastructure
Watermarked, serialised coupon generation with tamper-evident print design
Multi-station claim portal for physical coupon submission and validation
Agent credit system: redeemed coupons convert to bulk fuel order balance
Full coupon lifecycle audit trail from issuance to settlement

list.title: UN Peacekeeping Fuel Distribution System
list.summary: Challenge: The UNAMID UN peacekeeping mission in Darfur needed reliable fuel tracking for 60,000 vehicles, 14,000 generators, and 140 aircraft across 15 Petronas stations, in an environment with no reliable internet connectivity. Action: Designed a distributed offline-first database architecture: each field station recorded transactions to a local SQL Server instance, then automatically synchronised to the central Petronas HQ database in Khartoum whenever connectivity became available. All UN finance audit reports and fleet consumption dashboards generated from the centralised HQ database. Result: Continuous operational fuel tracking across the entire UNAMID fleet, with full audit compliance for UN finance reporting regardless of remote station connectivity.
outcomes: 60,000 vehicles tracked with per-transaction fuel consumption logs
14,000 generators on scheduled service and refuelling cycles
140 aircraft managed with aviation-grade fuel compliance records
15 dedicated Petronas stations operated exclusively for UNAMID
Offline-first distributed DB: field stations write to local SQL Server, sync to Khartoum HQ on available connection
UN finance audit reports and fleet dashboards from centralised HQ

list.title: US Government Healthcare Identity System
list.summary: Challenge: US government healthcare agencies needed a HIPAA-compliant medical data access system that eliminated centralised custody risk, where a single breach would expose patient records across multiple agencies. Action: Architected a Self-Sovereign Identity (SSI) system on Hyperledger Fabric: patients and providers receive cryptographic credentials for verifiable, zero-knowledge access to health records. No centralised data store. Each access event anchored on the Hyperledger network for tamper-evident audit. Built an interoperability layer across multiple government agency systems. Result: HIPAA-compliant, decentralised identity infrastructure replacing centralised data custody with cryptographic access control, auditable, patient-controlled, and breach-resistant by architecture.
outcomes: Hyperledger Fabric network for tamper-evident health record anchoring
SSI-based patient credential issuance with zero-knowledge proof verification
HIPAA-compliant tokenised access control replacing centralised data custody
Interoperability layer across multiple US government agency systems
Royal Caribbean digital pilot: experience tokens for VIP services and concierge automation
